preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner.
A victim user must hold a balance of the MetaPets token to execute a transfer.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first call `setMarketingWallet` to change the marketing address to an attacker-controlled address. Then, call `setMarketingFeePercent` to set a high marketing fee (e.g., 50). Finally, have a third-party account (the victim) execute a `transfer` of the contract's tokens. A large portion of this transfer will be diverted to the attacker's new marketing wallet, increasing their token balance.
